# Town of Worcester municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 28; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a selectboard
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names John Kaeding (Chair), Carter Stowell, and Jeffery Boudreau for Worcester

Town of Worcester, Directory page (live): Selectboard -- John Kaeding (Chair), Jeff Boudreau, and Carter Stowell. One three-year seat stood at the March 2026 meeting with the ballot outcome unpublished; all three are carried on incumbent-continuity (disclosed)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Jennifer LeStat as Worcester's Town Clerk
Town of Worcester, official minutes of the annual town meeting, March 3, 2026: Town Clerk Jennifer LeStat declared the polls open for the Australian ballot items and signed the minutes as Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer

Town of Worcester, Directory page (live): 'Town Treasurer/Tax Collector/Delinquent Taxes/Billing: Heather Pagel' at the treasurer's email address, and Delinquent Tax Collector Katie Miller listed separately. The Secretary of State's Guide (January 2026) and June 2026 spreadsheet name Katie Miller as treasurer, so a turnover occurred in 2026; its mechanism is unpublished, and Pagel is minted as an appointee (the vacancy-appointment reading) -- flagged on issue #163

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Town of Worcester Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: Town of Worcester, Directory page (live): Delinquent Tax Collector Katie Miller. The office was not on the March 2026 meeting's ballot list and no election evidence is published, so the holder is modeled appointed
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Worcester, official minutes of the annual town meeting, March 3, 2026: Article 1 -- Paul Hanlon was elected Moderator for the year ensuing and signed the minutes as Town Moderator
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a constable

Town of Worcester, official minutes of the annual town meeting, March 3, 2026: Article 4 -- Shawn McManus was elected Town Constable for the year ensuing. The town Directory prints 'Shawn M. McManis'; the signed minutes, the election record, govern (disclosed)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers

Town of Worcester, Directory page (live): Listers Peter Strobridge, Alan Erdossy, and Jonathan Scherbatskoy. Two lister seats stood at the March 2026 meeting (Article 2) with the ballot outcomes unpublished; the three are carried on the town's own current directory (disclosed). The minutes' motion credits print 'John Sherbatskoy'; the directory's full form governs
18 V.S.A. section 5373 provides for a three-member board of cemetery commissioners on staggered terms

Town of Worcester, official minutes of the annual town meeting, March 3, 2026: Article 5 -- Heather Pagel was elected Cemetery Commissioner for a term of three years. The board's size (3) follows the statute's three-member pattern and the single-seat three-year election in the minutes -- a flagged derivation; the other two seats' holders are unpublished
